_doc: The competitive arms' catalog ids run_ddp_ios_lm.py takes with --runtime (llama.cpp, executorch, mlx-swift) -> the Hub repo and the files the app reads, as in ios/BenchmarkApp/Sources/Models/ModelCatalog.swift (hfRepoId; primaryFile, plus the tokenizer an ExecuTorch export needs and the files an MLX snapshot needs). Each file is pushed to Documents/models/<runtime>/<hfRepoId with '/' as '__'>/<file>, HFDownloader.modelDirectory's path. An own export (own-export/...) is not on the Hub: pass its files with --model-file. models.json keeps the LiteRT-LM ids that Daisuke's self-test pins; the competitive LiteRT-LM export is here.
